Reasons for ending education
• Boys
• They fell into bad relations and leave schools.
• Leadership is lacked in home. Parents/Guardians do not care them properly
• They continue upto class 10 but when they fail the exam they became frustrated, don't want to be humiliated among their friends and leave school.
• Attraction of foreign employment and earn money.
• Due to poor economic condition of the house.
• Girls
• Marriage in an early age. There is one case in the village
• Not interested to study. They have a thinking that "What will happen through education? Ultimately we need to do kitchen work."
• Unsuccessful/failed in the exam then leave school.

• Seeing the migrated families from hills, Tharus now send their daughters to the school. Even the girls cannot pass the exam the families do not quit sending girls to school.
